قَفَّازٌ That leaps, jumps, springs, or bounds, much, or often; (A, * Msb;) [and so ↓ قَفُوزٌ , occurring in art. رفأ in the M and K, applied as an epithet to a gazelle.] ―
-b2- Hence, قَفَّازَةٌ A female slave: because she seldom remains still. You say, يَا ٱبْنَ القَفَّازَةِ O son of the female slave. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
